hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Judgment in the Division of Properties
Topics: Chapter Heading

hadiths.english_translation: Thawr ibn Zayd al-Dili reported: It reached me that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: 'Whichever house or land was divided during the pre-Islamic period (Jahiliyyah), then it remains according to the division of Jahiliyyah. And whichever house or land was reached by Islam and was not yet divided, then it is according to the division of Islam.'

hadiths.arabicText: حَدَّثَنِي /22 يَحْيَى /22 ، عَنْ /12 مَالِك /12 ، عَنْ /26 ثَوْرِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ الدِّيلِيِّ L2057 /26 ، أَنَّهُ قَالَ : بَلَغَنِي ، /27 أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ ، قَالَ : /20 " أَيُّمَا دَارٍ أَوْ أَرْضٍ قُسِمَتْ فِي الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ، فَهِيَ عَلَى قَسْمِ الْجَاهِلِيَّةِ ، وَأَيُّمَا دَارٍ أَوْ أَرْضٍ أَدْرَكَهَا الْإِسْلَامُ وَلَمْ تُقْسَمْ ، فَهِيَ عَلَى قَسْمِ الْإِسْلَامِ " /27 . قَالَ /22 يَحْيَى /22 : سَمِعْتُ /12 مَالِكًا /12 يَقُولُ ، فِيمَنْ هَلَكَ وَتَرَكَ أَمْوَالًا بِالْعَالِيَةِ وَالسَّافِلَةِ : /10 إِنَّ الْبَعْلَ لَا يُقْسَمُ مَعَ النَّضْحِ إِلَّا أَنْ يَرْضَى أَهْلُهُ بِذَلِكَ ، وَإِنَّ الْبَعْلَ يُقْسَمُ مَعَ الْعَيْنِ إِذَا كَانَ يُشْبِهُهَا ، وَأَنَّ الْأَمْوَالَ إِذَا كَانَتْ بِأَرْضٍ وَاحِدَةٍ الَّذِي بَيْنَهُمَا مُتَقَارِبٌ ، أَنَّهُ يُقَامُ كُلُّ مَالٍ مِنْهَا ، ثُمَّ يُقْسَمُ بَيْنَهُمْ وَالْمَسَاكِنُ وَالدُّورُ بِهَذِهِ الْمَنْزِلَةِ /10 *

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Judgment Concerning Predatory Animals and Livestock Under Guard
Topics: Chapter Heading

hadiths.english_translation: From Haram ibn Sa'd ibn Muhayyisa: That a she-camel belonging to al-Bara' ibn Azib entered a man's garden and caused damage in it. So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ judged that the people of the gardens must guard them during the day, and that whatever the livestock damage during the night is guaranteed upon their owners.

hadiths.english_translation: From Yahya ibn Abd al-Rahman ibn Hatib: That slaves belonging to Hatib stole a she-camel from a man of Muzaynah and slaughtered it. This was brought before Umar ibn al-Khattab, and Umar commanded Kathir ibn al-Salt to cut off their hands. Then Umar said, 'I see that you starve them.' Then Umar said, 'By Allah, I will surely fine you a fine that will be difficult for you.' Then he said to the Muzayni, 'How much is the price of your she-camel?' The Muzayni said, 'By Allah, I have been refusing (offers of) four hundred dirhams for it.' So Umar said, 'Give him eight hundred dirhams.'

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Judgment Concerning One Who Injures Animals
Topics: Chapter Heading
hadiths.arabicText: بَابُ الْقَضَاءِ فِيمَنْ أَصَابَ شَيْئًا مِنَ الْبَهَائِمِ

hadiths.english_translation: Yahya said: I heard Malik saying: The practice among us concerning one who injures an animal is that upon the one who injured it is the measure of what decreased from its price. Yahya said: And I heard Malik saying concerning a camel that attacks a man and he fears for himself so he kills it or hamstrings it: If he has witnesses that it intended to attack him and did attack him, then there is no liability upon him. But if he has no proof except his own statement, then he is liable for the camel.

hadiths.arabicText: @ قَالَ /22 يَحْيَى /22 : سَمِعْتُ /12 مَالِكًا /12 ، يَقُولُ : /10 الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا فِيمَنْ أَصَابَ شَيْئًا مِنَ الْبَهَائِمِ ، إِنَّ عَلَى الَّذِي أَصَابَهَا قَدْرَ مَا نَقَصَ مِنْ ثَمَنِهَا /10 . قَالَ /22 يَحْيَى /22 : وَسَمِعْتُ /12 مَالِكًا /12 يَقُولُ ، فِي الْجَمَلِ يَصُولُ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ فَيَخَافُهُ عَلَى نَفْسِهِ فَيَقْتُلُهُ أَوْ يَعْقِرُهُ : /10 فَإِنَّهُ إِنْ كَانَتْ لَهُ بَيِّنَةٌ عَلَى أَنَّهُ أَرَادَهُ وَصَالَ عَلَيْهِ فَلَا غُرْمَ عَلَيْهِ ، وَإِنْ لَمْ تَقُمْ لَهُ بَيِّنَةٌ إِلَّا مَقَالَتُهُ فَهُوَ ضَامِنٌ لِلْجَمَلِ /10 . #

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Judgment Concerning What is Given to Workers
Topics: Chapter Heading

hadiths.english_translation: Yahya said: I heard Malik saying concerning one who hands to a washer a garment to dye it, and he dyes it, then the owner of the garment says 'I did not order you to use this dye,' and the washer says 'Rather, you ordered me to do that': The washer is believed in that, and similarly the tailor in similar matters, and the goldsmith in similar matters, and they must take an oath on that unless they bring something they are not employed to do, then their statement is not valid in that, and the owner of the garment must take an oath. If he refuses and declines to take an oath, then the dyer must take an oath. He said: And I heard Malik saying concerning a dyer to whom a garment is handed and he makes a mistake with it and hands it to another man until the one to whom he gave it wears it: There is no liability upon the one who wore it, and the washer is liable to the owner of the garment. That is if he wore the garment that was handed to him without knowing that it was not his. But if he wore it while knowing it was not his garment, then he is liable for it.

hadiths.arabicText: @ قَالَ /22 يَحْيَى /22 : سَمِعْتُ /12 مَالِكًا /12 يَقُولُ ، فِيمَنْ دَفَعَ إِلَى الْغَسَّالِ ثَوْبًا يَصْبُغُهُ فَصَبَغَهُ ، فَقَالَ صَاحِبُ الثَّوْبِ : لَمْ آمُرْكَ بِهَذَا الصِّبْغِ ، وَقَالَ الْغَسَّالُ : بَلْ أَنْتَ أَمَرْتَنِي بِذَلِكَ : /10 فَإِنَّ الْغَسَّالَ مُصَدَّقٌ فِي ذَلِكَ ، وَالْخَيَّاطُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ ، وَالصَّائِغُ مِثْلُ ذَلِكَ ، وَيَحْلِفُونَ عَلَى ذَلِكَ إِلَّا أَنْ يَأْتُوا بِأَمْرٍ لَا يُسْتَعْمَلُونَ فِي مِثْلِهِ ، فَلَا يَجُوزُ قَوْلُهُمْ فِي ذَلِكَ ، وَلْيَحْلِفْ صَاحِبُ الثَّوْبِ ، فَإِنْ رَدَّهَا وَأَبَى أَنْ يَحْلِفَ حُلِّفَ الصَّبَّاغُ /10 . قَالَ : وَسَمِعْتُ /12 مَالِكًا /12 يَقُولُ ، فِي الصَّبَّاغِ يُدْفَعُ إِلَيْهِ الثَّوْبُ ، فَيُخْطِئُ بِهِ ، فَيَدْفَعُهُ إِلَى رَجُلٍ آخَرَ حَتَّى يَلْبَسَهُ الَّذِي أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ : /10 إِنَّهُ لَا غُرْمَ عَلَى الَّذِي لَبِسَهُ ، وَيَغْرَمُ الْغَسَّالُ لِصَاحِبِ الثَّوْبِ ، وَذَلِكَ إِذَا لَبِسَ الثَّوْبَ الَّذِي دُفِعَ إِلَيْهِ عَلَى غَيْرِ مَعْرِفَةٍ ، بِأَنَّهُ لَيْسَ لَهُ ، فَإِنْ لَبِسَهُ وَهُوَ يَعْرِفُ أَنَّهُ لَيْسَ ثَوْبَهُ فَهُوَ ضَامِنٌ لَهُ /10 . #

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Judgment Concerning Guarantees and Transfers of Debt
Topics: Chapter Heading

hadiths.english_translation: Yahya said: I heard Malik saying: The practice among us concerning a man who transfers another man to a (third) man with a debt owed to him is: If the one to whom he was transferred goes bankrupt or dies without leaving enough to pay, then the transferee has no claim against the one who transferred him, and he cannot return to his first debtor. Malik said: This is the practice about which there is no disagreement among us. Malik said: As for a man for whom another man guarantees a debt owed by yet another man, then the guarantor dies or goes bankrupt, then the one for whom the guarantee was made returns to his first debtor.

hadiths.arabicText: @ قَالَ /22 يَحْيَى /22 : سَمِعْتُ /12 مَالِكًا /12 ، يَقُولُ : /10 الْأَمْرُ عِنْدَنَا فِي الرَّجُلِ يُحِيلُ الرَّجُلَ عَلَى الرَّجُلِ بِدَيْنٍ لَهُ عَلَيْهِ : أَنَّهُ إِنْ أَفْلَسَ الَّذِي أُحِيلَ عَلَيْهِ أَوْ مَاتَ فَلَمْ يَدَعْ وَفَاءً ، فَلَيْسَ لِلْمُحْتَالِ عَلَى الَّذِي أَحَالَهُ شَيْءٌ ، وَأَنَّهُ لَا يَرْجِعُ عَلَى صَاحِبِهِ الْأَوَّلِ /10 . قَالَ /12 مَالِك /12 : /10 وَهَذَا الْأَمْرُ الَّذِي لَا اخْتِلَافَ فِيهِ عِنْدَنَا /10 . قَالَ /12 مَالِك /12 : /10 فَأَمَّا الرَّجُلُ يَتَحَمَّلُ لَهُ الرَّجُلُ بِدَيْنٍ لَهُ عَلَى رَجُلٍ آخَرَ ، ثُمَّ يَهْلِكُ الْمُتَحَمِّلُ أَوْ يُفْلِسُ ، فَإِنَّ الَّذِي تُحُمِّلَ لَهُ يَرْجِعُ عَلَى غَرِيمِهِ الْأَوَّلِ /10 . #6E389

hadiths.english_translation: Chapter: Judgment Concerning One Who Purchases a Garment with a Defect
Topics: Chapter Heading
hadiths.arabicText: بَابُ الْقَضَاءِ فِيمَنِ ابْتَاعَ ثَوْبًا وَبِهِ عَيْبٌ

hadiths.english_translation: Yahya said: I heard Malik saying: When a man purchases a garment that has a defect such as burning or other than that, which the seller knew about and it was witnessed against him regarding that or he acknowledged it, then the purchaser made a change in it such as cutting that decreases the price of the garment, then the purchaser learned of the defect, it is returned to the seller and there is no liability upon the purchaser for his cutting it. He said: And if a man purchases a garment that has a defect from burning or damage, and the one who sold it claimed that he did not know about that, and the purchaser had cut the garment or dyed it, then the purchaser has a choice: if he wishes, the amount by which the burning or damage decreased the price of the garment can be deducted and he keeps the garment, or if he wishes, he can pay what the cutting or dyeing decreased from the price of the garment and return it. He has the choice in that. If the purchaser had dyed the garment with a dye that increases its price, then the purchaser has a choice: if he wishes, the amount by which the defect decreased the price of the garment can be deducted, or if he wishes, he can become a partner with the one who sold him the garment. It is examined how much the price of the garment is with the burning or damage in it. If its price was ten dirhams and the price of what the dye increased in it was five dirhams, then they become partners in the garment, each of them according to his share. According to this calculation is what the dye increased in the price of the garment.

hadiths.arabicText: @ قَالَ /22 يَحْيَى /22 : سَمِعْتُ /12 مَالِكًا /12 ، يَقُولُ : /10 إِذَا ابْتَاعَ الرَّجُلُ ثَوْبًا وَبِهِ عَيْبٌ مِنْ حَرْقٍ أَوْ غَيْرِهِ ، قَدْ عَلِمَهُ الْبَائِعُ فَشُهِدَ عَلَيْهِ بِذَلِكَ أَوْ أَقَرَّ بِهِ فَأَحْدَثَ فِيهِ الَّذِي ابْتَاعَهُ حَدَثًا مِنْ تَقْطِيعٍ يُنَقِّصُ ثَمَنَ الثَّوْبِ ، ثُمَّ عَلِمَ الْمُبْتَاعُ بِالْعَيْبِ ، فَهُوَ رَدٌّ عَلَى الْبَائِعِ وَلَيْسَ عَلَى الَّذِي ابْتَاعَهُ غُرْمٌ فِي تَقْطِيعِهِ إِيَّاهُ . قَالَ : وَإِنِ ابْتَاعَ رَجُلٌ ثَوْبًا وَبِهِ عَيْبٌ مِنْ حَرْقٍ أَوْ عَوَارٍ ، فَزَعَمَ الَّذِي بَاعَهُ أَنَّهُ لَمْ يَعْلَمْ بِذَلِكَ وَقَدْ قَطَعَ الثَّوْبَ الَّذِي ابْتَاعَهُ أَوْ صَبَغَهُ ، فَالْمُبْتَاعُ بِالْخِيَارِ إِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يُوضَعَ عَنْهُ قَدْرُ مَا نَقَصَ الْحَرْقُ أَوِ الْعَوَارُ مِنْ ثَمَنِ الثَّوْبِ وَيُمْسِكُ الثَّوْبَ فَعَلَ ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَغْرَمَ مَا نَقَصَ التَّقْطِيعُ أَوِ الصِّبْغُ مِنْ ثَمَنِ الثَّوْبِ ، وَيَرُدُّهُ فَعَلَ ، وَهُوَ فِي ذَلِكَ بِالْخِيَارِ ، فَإِنْ كَانَ الْمُبْتَاعُ قَدْ صَبَغَ الثَّوْبَ صِبْغًا يَزِيدُ فِي ثَمَنِهِ ، فَالْمُبْتَاعُ بِالْخِيَارِ ، إِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يُوضَعَ عَنْهُ قَدْرُ مَا نَقَصَ الْعَيْبُ مِنْ ثَمَنِ الثَّوْبِ ، وَإِنْ شَاءَ أَنْ يَكُونَ شَرِيكًا لِلَّذِي بَاعَهُ الثَّوْبَ فَعَلَ ، وَيُنْظَرُ كَمْ ثَمَنُ الثَّوْبِ وَفِيهِ الْحَرْقُ أَوِ الْعَوَارُ ، فَإِنْ كَانَ ثَمَنُهُ عَشَرَةَ دَرَاهِمَ وَثَمَنُ مَا زَادَ فِيهِ الصِّبْغُ خَمْسَةَ دَرَاهِمَ كَانَا شَرِيكَيْنِ فِي الثَّوْبِ لِكُلِّ وَاحِدٍ مِنْهُمَا بِقَدْرِ حِصَّتِهِ ، فَعَلَى حِسَابِ هَذَا يَكُونُ مَا زَادَ الصِّبْغُ فِي ثَمَنِ الثَّوْبِ /10 . #

hadiths.arabicText: بَابُ مَا لَا يَجُوزُ مِنَ النُّحْلِ

hadiths.english_translation: Narrated by al-Nu'man ibn Bashir: That his father Bashir brought him to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and said, 'I have given this son of mine a slave boy who belonged to me.' So the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Have you given all your children the like of this?' He said, 'No.' The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, 'Then take it back.'

potential_issues.issue: Malik ibn Anas uses 'an (عَنْ) and is a category 1 mudallis according to some scholars, though he is among the most reliable narrators.

potential_issues.issue: Ibn Shihab al-Zuhri uses the indirect term 'an (عَنْ) and is classified as a category 3 mudallis by some scholars (like Ibn Hajar). However, al-Zuhri is one of the most reliable narrators in Islamic scholarship and his tadlis is generally overlooked by the majority of scholars.
potential_issues.impact: While technically noteworthy, al-Zuhri's exceptional reliability and the fact that two independent narrators (Humayd and Muhammad ibn al-Nu'man) both narrate this hadith to him using the direct term 'haddathaahu' significantly strengthens the chain. Minimal practical impact.

potential_issues.issue: The final link uses 'an (عَنْ) from al-Nu'man ibn Bashir, but since al-Nu'man is a Companion reporting about his own incident, this is not problematic.
